integrity: Derivations and exact-rational finite checks distinguish the all-period theorem from finite illustration. General diffusivity formulas are explicitly credited; historical priority of the global placement theorem is not independently established.
scientific_limitations: Continuous-time homogeneous-direction-bias nearest-neighbor periodic walks, exactly two positive clock classes, fixed class counts. Velocity and long-time displacement variance only; no general correlated-time, bias-disorder, or higher-cumulant claims.
title: Balanced kinetic defects minimize fluctuation without changing drift in periodic biased transport
